acceptance_predicates.description: LiveUpgradeBinding is consumed by the production admission path before any phase capability is constructed.
Persisted binding records reject internally inconsistent contract and runtime identities.
Real Git and SQLite durable scope and adapter integration covers stale, foreign, released, ambiguous, missing, and process-death boundaries.
Synthetic callbacks and unsupported mutation paths remain rejected.

definition_of_done: Production admission consumes the live binding and real durable integration tests pass.
Exact-head independent review, hosted checks, post-merge verification, and reconciliation pass.
No source-to-model refinement proof or authorization prerequisite is required.

inputs.description: Current production upgrade command and lock-domain state.

outputs.description: Production admission boundary that requires current durable session/backend identity.

gates.description: The production path is bound to live durable state, not a synthetic fixture.
Ambiguity is durable and cannot be retried as success.
A distinct reviewer checks the exact candidate head.
